taxonomy_notes: Euseius coccosocius was first described in 1967 by Ghai and Menon, based on holotype and paratype females collected from mango leaves (M. indica) in Bangalore, Karnataka, India, where it was associated with scale insects. Gupta (1986) provided a relatively detailed description, including setal measurements, based on specimens collected from various locations in India, including the type locality. Their morphological characters and measurements perfectly match the redescriptions provided by Gupta (1986, 2003).
